Shiv Sena faction tears pages from Sonia Gandhi's book, demands ban

A faction of Shiv Sena, led by Eknath Shinde, tore pages from a book authored by Sonia Gandhi and demanded its ban. The party accused Gandhi of insulting Veer Savarkar and Marathi identity. The YSRCP and BRS also expressed anger over the book's content.
